plans.name: Community
plans.summary: The complete local application atlas for individual developers and local CI.

plans.name: Hosted workspace
plans.summary: A possible GitHub-connected workspace for shared projects, retained history, and an organization MCP server.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.summary: A future boundary for self-hosting, identity controls, auditability, and adapter support.

features.title: Application atlas
features.summary: Open routes on Paper-matched selected-screen evidence, then switch to a reload-safe `?canvas=map` GPU atlas with deterministic landscape regions, top-anchored selected-region framing that reveals adjacent product territory, automatic or project-owned areas, nested route ancestry, smart oversized-domain districts, hierarchy lanes, bounded snapshot thumbnails, explicit Area, Region, and Atlas focus levels, semantic-zoom labels, measured collision-safe region and area headers, a shared adaptive dot field, compact route families, exact discovery-adapter provenance, and one cancellation-safe Pixi lifecycle shared by every GPU surface; inspect each component through a Paper-matched coverage rail, addressable source-declared preview variants with exact captured, failed, unavailable, or uncaptured evidence, and an exact usedBy-resolved consuming-screen fallback for source-less gaps, then switch to an addressable complete map of searchable automatic or project-owned source domains with exact coverage, route usage, collapsible selected-group-aware navigation, automatic selected-item reveal, adaptive centered landscape rows, and machine-readable scene geometry; organize explicit directed flows into adaptive centered lane rows with nearest-lane focus and exact edge preservation; then drill into profile-aware live screens, capture-backed previews, findings, and notes through explicit focus controls, bounded addressable selections, a complete searchable Editor evidence inventory with disclosed preview limits and exact cross-destination identities, readable count-aware Atlas navigation, and the machine-checked 23-board Studio shell with exact 14px side and bottom canvas insets, including a coherent 128-component Fieldbase demo without numbered filler.

features.title: API endpoint atlas
features.summary: Discover and merge source-backed and OpenAPI/Swagger HTTP operations through one extensible snapshot-sharing adapter seam; retain versioned method, path, request, response, security, framework, adapter, source, contract, and malformed-evidence records in the normalized graph; inspect and search them through a bounded Studio APIs view with readable domain grouping, source-versus-contract filters, honest empty states, and contextual links back to consuming screens and inferred journeys; query the complete model through JSONL, daemon, CLI, and MCP; verify expected endpoint coverage across Next.js, TanStack, React, Vue, Nuxt, and Svelte fixtures; and enforce separate 10,000-operation source and OpenAPI hot-path p95 budgets at or below 50 ms.

features.title: Automatic project understanding
features.summary: Recognize framework families and project capabilities from one immutable source snapshot; discover source-backed links, navigation, redirects, forms, fetches, and Axios calls through an extensible flow-adapter seam; resolve them to canonical screens and API endpoints; derive bounded read-only journey candidates with confidence and source evidence; refresh graph, Studio, JSONL, daemon, CLI, and MCP records after one reported source change; and keep computed targets visible as issues without executing application code.

features.title: Project-wide Studio search
features.summary: Search routes, screen states, API endpoints, components, flows, flow steps, notes, findings, interaction probes, Doctor checks, destinations, and actions through one deterministic keyboard-navigable lazy palette that preserves addressable stable entity selection, reload retention, extension-safe destination ownership, environment-aware action availability, and platform-correct shortcut guidance.

features.title: Performance benchmark contract
features.summary: Measure and compare the local scan-to-scene pipeline, 10,000-route discovery for all six built-in framework families, separate 10,000-operation source API, OpenAPI, and source-flow discovery, daemon, packaged CLI, batched capture, public website, and production Studio through versioned machine-readable evidence: 21-sample CPU and system profiles, median-and-p95 before/after gates, a 50 ms hot-operation ceiling, exact runtime/workload fingerprints, persistent source and static-analysis snapshots, semantic no-op detection, idle-coalesced graph and LLM durability with read-time settlement, parsed-state reuse with external invalidation, a thin lazy CLI bootstrap, shared-browser isolated capture contexts, atomic evidence batches, route-specific Studio module preloads, the real on-demand Pixi host, separate camera work and external display cadence, three-phase browser heap evidence, bounded texture pressure, cold-page LCP and main-thread-stall checks, lazy Studio assets, native framework fixtures, all 23 boards, signed profiles, visual comparison, and the complete native-app-to-LLM workflow.

features.title: Studio extension API
features.summary: Customize installed Studio with project-owned loopback destinations and declarative commands, or source Studio with component destinations and function commands, using one keyed add, edit, and remove model with derived defaults, safe fallback, inspectable shipped board/frame data, and bounded addressable selection actions.

features.title: Adapter scaffolding and inventory
features.summary: Create collision-safe local framework, API-endpoint, flow-discovery, component-preview, or application-runtime adapters, verify manifest and module identity plus each public contract through one bounded process-free report, then inspect a versioned inventory that merges built-ins, project scaffolds, configured modules, observed framework, endpoint, flow, and preview contributions, exact screen/endpoint/transition/journey/component membership, activation evidence, and malformed-manifest issues across daemon, Studio, LLM exports, and MCP.

features.title: Contained derived-cache lifecycle
features.summary: Inspect or clean only regenerable .topo/cache data through one symlink-safe module shared by CLI, daemon, and Studio, with dry-run and typed JSON evidence.

features.title: Reversible project setup
features.summary: Detect Next.js, TanStack, React, Vue, Nuxt, and Svelte applications plus local tooling, preview every operation, apply a transactional setup, migrate versioned project metadata, reconcile the installed CLI without touching lockfiles, and uninstall only hash-verified managed files while preserving user records.

features.title: One-command local Studio
features.summary: Start the native application, isolated profile gateways, daemon, and compiled Studio through one transactional topo dev runtime with loopback-only hosting, fixture-isolated production startup, runtime-validated versioned daemon resources including sanitized project and capture settings, latest-wins resource hydration, synchronous exclusive Studio actions, manifest-enforced on-demand review rendering, real bounded Studio preferences, natively labeled and stably named authoring controls, theme-correct AA semantic text contrast, manifest-backed About actions, fail-closed malformed graphs and disconnected writes, an exact scene-v4 regional route map with stable machine-readable topology metrics that mounts no speculative frames, explicit Screen-mode signed iframe promotion, exact-origin CSP-safe visual evidence, deep links, 23-board proof, durable note and LLM evidence, and deterministic shutdown.

features.title: Managed native application runtime
features.summary: Reuse or start the inspected application's real local development server through validated Next.js, TanStack, Nuxt, Vite, generic package-script, configured-command, or project-installed runtime adapters, with readiness evidence and owned process-tree cleanup.

features.title: Monorepo project model
features.summary: Resolve one explicit project root for configuration and durable LLM-readable artifacts and one existing application source root for framework scanning, diagnostics, preview construction, and native commands; support nested, adjacent, linked, or absolute source selection while keeping every durable Topo write owned by the project root.

features.title: Compiler-grade source intelligence
features.summary: Parse JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, and TSX with the native Oxc compiler binding; catalog Vue and Svelte single-file components and analyze their template interactions without pretending to expose compiler ASTs; retain direct imports, value re-exports, callable exports, required-prop evidence, bounded unchanged-file reuse, and transitive route-to-component coverage; keep one serialized daemon scanner session that updates reported files while retaining unchanged source and loaded adapters, then rebuild the complete graph without executing application code.

features.title: Next.js adapter
features.summary: Discover App Router and Pages Router routes through a validated, read-only framework adapter, with executable fixtures spanning exact graph states, LLM flows, native runtimes, and browser contracts.

features.title: TanStack adapter
features.summary: Discover TanStack Router and Start routes through generated full-path contracts with a validated filename fallback, current and legacy Start package detection, and executable Router and SSR Start fixtures.

features.title: React adapter
features.summary: Discover ordinary React applications, static absolute React Router JSX and route-object declarations, or a routerless application root through a conservative read-only adapter, with Vite runtime, dynamic preview, LLM flow, and Chromium fixture evidence.

features.title: Vue adapter
features.summary: Discover ordinary Vue applications, static absolute Vue Router records, or a routerless application root through a conservative read-only adapter, with single-file-component indexing, Vite runtime, dynamic preview, LLM flow, and Chromium fixture evidence.

features.title: Nuxt adapter
features.summary: Discover Nuxt pages, route groups, dynamic, optional, catch-all, mode-suffixed, application-root, and global error states only when Nuxt project markers are present, with native Nuxt runtime, preview, LLM flow, and Chromium fixture evidence.

features.title: Svelte adapter
features.summary: Discover SvelteKit page and error routes with route groups, matchers, dynamic, optional, and rest segments or expose a standalone Svelte application root, with single-file-component indexing, Vite runtime, preview, LLM flow, and Chromium fixture evidence.

features.title: Screen capture
features.summary: Capture canonical static and parameterized application screens through validated project-owned preview paths, expose one versioned non-secret auto-capture, headless, and viewport policy to Studio and bounded project context, capture readiness-verified component previews, plan exact or conservative source-change impacts, preserve unaffected evidence, and publish hash-versioned local image URLs.

features.title: Visual baselines and comparisons
features.summary: Accept explicit local screen baselines through serialized atomic project state, skip pixel decoding when hashes match, produce real pixel metrics and diff images when they do not, and inspect the evidence through Studio, daemon, LLM context, and MCP.

features.title: Versioned Markdown notes
features.summary: Compose, create, search, inspect, edit, resolve, re-anchor, place, filter, navigate, and delete typed route, flow, or free-standing notes through an evidence-first Studio workbench or complete strict CLI CRUD while keeping lifecycle, target, anchor, and LLM projection evidence readable and committable, with exact source-backed live or captured screen evidence, deliberate normalized point or region placement, and current semantic element evidence from signed live frames.

features.title: User flows
features.summary: Create, trace from signed live previews, edit, connect, verify, inspect, and safely remove authoritative branching versioned flows through collision-safe atomic JSON storage, CLI and daemon CRUD, exact-origin sanitized navigation subscriptions, canonical dynamic-route matching, cancellable ephemeral Studio recording, explicit next-step topology, route-resolution evidence, readable selected-lane framing with nearest-flow context, exact edge-preserving scene geometry, and synchronized LLM records; separately inspect derived source-backed journey candidates without writing or mislabeling them as recorded flows.

features.title: Review exports
features.summary: Generate the same source-backed review evidence as Markdown, SARIF 2.1.0, or escaped standalone HTML through Studio, daemon, CLI, and MCP, with optional non-binary snapshot references and manifest-enforced on-demand Studio loading.

features.title: Canonical Doctor report
features.summary: Inspect canonical environment, security, application-source selection, and runtime readiness checks through one report shared by CLI, daemon, Studio, context files, and MCP; copy disclosed remediation, triage every source finding without truncation, and open an exact addressable finding beside its source-backed live, captured, or explicitly unseen screen evidence.

features.title: Interaction diagnostics
features.summary: Exclude explicit disabled states, safely probe selected-route controls, address every route observation through exact Studio search, target switching, and reload-safe probe links, let a browser-local Studio preference explicitly include bounded runtime probes after Doctor, persist every typed effect or safety skip, report possibly inert interactions without declaring them broken, and expose the same evidence through a bounded schema-versioned CLI quality gate.

features.title: LLM-readable context
features.summary: Project every durable and derived Topo concept through one indexed graph read into schema-v7 records with fast fixed-envelope validation equivalent to the exported runtime schemas, stable relationships, bounded queries, recognized framework and capability evidence, complete API endpoints, source transitions, inferred journeys and steps, malformed-source records, sanitized version-one capture policy, exact route-region and component source-group atlas placement, canonical reciprocal parent/child route hierarchy, project-owned adapter manifests, bidirectional adapter ownership for routes, screens, endpoints, flow evidence, and component previews, visual baseline and comparison evidence, and auditable newest-first job retention while excluding preview capabilities and secrets.

features.title: Local MCP server
features.summary: Give coding agents read-only, bounded structured access to routes, API endpoints, screens, components, flows, notes, findings, local-adapter context, capture, baseline, and visual-diff artifacts, plus configured route-family organization and versioned overview, selected-screen, component, and flow scenes through the official MCP SDK.

features.title: Signed preview gateway
features.summary: Isolate each local preview profile on a distinct loopback host behind an opaque expiring session while forwarding native HTTP and HMR behavior, injecting bounded credential-free preview instrumentation with exact-origin snapshot and live-event subscriptions into eligible signed HTML, and leaving production authentication unchanged.

features.title: Storybook ingestion
features.summary: Discover colocated Storybook states, resolve their real index IDs, and capture them as evidence-backed Topo component previews.

features.title: Standalone component previews
features.summary: Discover Storybook, colocated, keyed configured, safe automatic, and explicitly accepted generated component variants with deterministic provenance and priority; create contained no-overwrite colocated drafts from connected Studio while keeping required-prop fixtures inactive and LLM-readable as findings; render native sources through a capability-scoped loopback runtime; and capture ready or failed evidence without requiring a custom adapter.

features.title: Public product website
features.summary: Present canonical installation, documentation, and pricing direction, then package the verified production Studio as a same-origin demo with a deterministic project.

features.title: Documentation governance
features.summary: Fail quality gates when feature status, evidence, canonical docs, local links, generated history, executable CI coverage, or the guarded token-free release workflow drift apart.

features.title: Packaged CLI preview
features.summary: Build, release-contract-check, retain, and consumer-test one self-contained ESM CLI tarball with the compiled Studio, version-two five-check loading evidence including deferred review rendering, explicit Node-compatible runtime dependencies, exact version-tag binding, and guarded token-free npm provenance; npm publication remains pending.

features.title: Hosted workspaces
features.summary: Manage multiple retained Topo projects and review history in one shared workspace.

features.title: GitHub project connection
features.summary: Connect repositories to shared Topo projects and produce retained pull-request review context.

features.title: Organization MCP
features.summary: Query governed project context and retained review history through a hosted organization-scoped MCP server.
